This is absolutely record-breaking — Apple is now seeding the sixth round of developer and public release candidates (RCs) for macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8. Here's what you need to know.

Apple Seeds 6th RCs for macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and Sequoia 15.7.8

If you thought the fifth RC of macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8 would be the final build before the official updates, Apple clearly has other plans.

The company is now seeding a sixth RC of both operating systems, and given the timing, they will very likely include important security patches. Apple recently pushed out iOS, iPadOS, and macOS 26.5.2, which contained fixes originally slated for the 26.6 release — pushed out early due to risks posed by new AI tools.

Beyond the default release notes stating "This update includes important security improvements and is recommended for all users," Apple has not yet disclosed the details of these updates. The build numbers for today's RCs are:

The build numbers for today's RCs are:

  • macOS Sonoma 14.8.8: 23J619
  • macOS Sequoia 15.7.8: 24G822
